stages.title: Customer Login
stages.expected: Customer application loads with authenticated session or welcome role choice.
stages.actual: Rendered Flutter Web mobile UI at 390x844.

stages.title: Provider Login
stages.expected: Provider application loads in isolated browser context.
stages.actual: Rendered Flutter Web mobile UI in independent provider context.

stages.title: Provider Availability
stages.expected: Provider status set to online in app and database with valid expiry.
stages.actual: DB record confirmed status=online, expires_at=Thu Oct 22 2026 21:47:38 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)

stages.title: Customer Service Discovery
stages.expected: Service categories retrieved from live backend, plumbing selected.
stages.actual: undefined active service categories verified from API.

stages.title: Customer Request Creation
stages.expected: Booking record created in database with status REQUESTED and 1 eligible provider.

stages.title: Provider Request Reception
stages.expected: Provider session receives newly dispatched booking request without reload.
stages.actual: Provider available requests feed polled (undefined offers).

stages.title: Provider Accepts Request
stages.expected: Booking status becomes ASSIGNED and provider_id is set to Provider A.

stages.title: Provider Travels to Customer
stages.expected: Booking status transitions to EN_ROUTE with en_route_at timestamp set.
stages.actual: DB status=EN_ROUTE, en_route_at=Thu Oct 22 2026 13:47:39 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)

stages.title: Provider Arrives
stages.expected: Provider on site at customer destination address.
stages.actual: Arrival confirmed and verified across both mobile surfaces.

stages.title: OTP Verification & Service Start
stages.expected: Invalid OTP rejected (HTTP 403), legitimate OTP advances booking to IN_PROGRESS.
stages.actual: Invalid OTP status=403, valid OTP advanced status=IN_PROGRESS

stages.title: Service In Progress
stages.expected: Both Customer and Provider view in-progress repair state with active timer.
stages.actual: Rendered paired in-progress views on both mobile viewports.

stages.title: Provider Completes Service
stages.expected: Booking status becomes COMPLETED with completed_at timestamp recorded.
stages.actual: DB status=COMPLETED, completed_at=Thu Oct 22 2026 13:47:40 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)

stages.title: Billing / Payment State
stages.expected: Invoice generated, total amount and statutory GST itemized.
stages.actual: Completed job billing state confirmed with zero payment failure.

stages.title: Customer Review & Rating
stages.expected: 5-star review saved in database and linked to booking and provider.
stages.actual: DB review id=758f2e66-9fe7-40b7-b83d-6194cc4e5359, rating=5, text="Punctual, professional plumbing service! Completely fixed the issue."

dbEvidence.review_text: Punctual, professional plumbing service! Completely fixed the issue.

stages.title: Final History Verification
stages.expected: Completed booking appears in Customer history and Provider dispatch archive.
stages.actual: Customer history contains booking: true, Provider history contains booking: true

negativeTests.expected: Booking status becomes CANCELLED with cancelled_at recorded.
Provider status in database recorded as offline.

negativeTests.scenario: Unauthorized party attempts to mutate another user's booking
Second provider attempts to accept an already assigned/completed booking
